Class NmrMLReader

java.lang.Object
global.thalion.ttio.importers.NmrMLReader
public final class NmrMLReader extends Object
SAX-based parser for nmrML files.

Extracts acquisition parameters (spectrometer frequency, nucleus, number of scans, dwell time), FID data, and processed spectrum data. Returns an AcquisitionRun with Enums.AcquisitionMode.NMR_1D mode, chemical_shift and intensity channels, and optionally a FreeInductionDecay.

API status: Stable.

Cross-language equivalents:
Objective-C: TTIONmrMLReader · Python: ttio.importers.nmrml

  • Field Details

    • PROGRESS_INTERVAL_SPECTRA

      public static final int PROGRESS_INTERVAL_SPECTRA
      nmrML files canonically carry one 1-D spectrum (and optionally a FID). The progress contract for this reader is therefore a single final fire of (1, 1) after the parse succeeds.

    • read

      public static NmrMLReader.NmrMLResult read(InputStream is, String name, ProgressSink progress) throws NmrMLParseException
      Overload of read(InputStream, String) that accepts a ProgressSink. Fires progress.onProgress(1, 1) once the spectrum has been parsed; total is always 1 because nmrML's canonical structure holds a single 1-D spectrum (plus an optional FID, which is part of the same logical acquisition).
      Throws:
      NmrMLParseException
      Since:
      1.5.0
